posts.title: Laid off 15 minutes before all-hands with zero warning
posts.body: Logged into my laptop this morning to find Slack deactivated and an email from HR. What a fucking cowardly way to discard employees after 4 years of grinding. Swear these corporate executives have no spine.
posts.author: priya

posts.title: How long did your severance package payout take?
posts.body: Got severance documents yesterday. Agreement says 30 business days. Did anyone get theirs earlier or do they drag it out?
posts.author: rahul

posts.title: Reintegrated at ByteForge after 5 grueling months
posts.body: After 180 applications and endless ghosting, signed an offer today as Staff Engineer at ByteForge. Do not lose hope. The market is shit right now, but your value is real.
posts.author: meera

posts.title: Silent layoffs happening in infra team right now
posts.body: They called it 'performance realignment', but 12 senior engineers just vanished from the directory. Classic stealth layoff strategy so they dont report WARN notices.
posts.author: aman

posts.title: Should I sign the non-disparagement clause?
posts.body: Standard NDA clause in the severance packet. Two months pay attached to it. What did you folks do?
posts.author: neha

posts.title: Signed my new contract today. We survived.
posts.body: Three months after getting cut from MegaCorp, starting as Senior Backend Dev on Monday. Waffle Party time. Keep going everyone.
posts.author: sam

posts.title: Townhall was a complete circus today
posts.body: CEO literally said 'we are a family' right after axing 200 people. You dont fire family over Google Meet, you greedy hypocrites.
posts.author: priya

posts.title: Anyone transitioning from design to front-end?
posts.body: Seeing way more FE openings than pure product design right now. Looking for tips on bridging the gap quickly.
posts.author: neha

posts.title: Worst severance package you have ever received?
posts.body: StartupZero offered 2 weeks after 3 years. Fucking insulting. Share your worst stories so we can laugh through the misery.
posts.author: sam

posts.title: Health insurance cobra costs are criminal
posts.body: Quoted $1,400 a month for COBRA continuation. Who the hell has fourteen hundred bucks a month when they just lost their income?
posts.author: rahul

posts.title: Tips for handling recruiter ghosting?
posts.body: Made it to 4 rounds of interviews, then complete radio silence. How do you all handle the mental fatigue?
posts.author: priya

posts.title: Unpopular opinion: Being severed was the best thing that happened to me
posts.body: I was working 70 hour weeks burning out for a company that replaced me in 10 minutes. It gave me my life back.
posts.author: meera

posts.title: Contracting vs full-time while job hunting?
posts.body: Got an offer for a 3-month contract. Will it hurt my chances for full-time roles or keep me afloat?
posts.author: rahul

posts.title: TechNova cutting another 10% next quarter according to leadership leak
posts.body: VP slipped up during QBR planning. If you are on probation or PIP, start interviewing elsewhere yesterday.
posts.author: aman

posts.title: Controversial take: severance packages should be legally mandated
posts.body: One week per year of service is pure exploitation. European workers get months of notice. US and Indian labor laws need reform.
posts.author: priya

posts.title: Rejoined startup ecosystem after 6 months severance
posts.body: Back in the game as Principal Architect at StartupZero. Thanks to everyone here who gave mock interviews.
posts.author: aman

posts.title: How to explain a 6-month employment gap to conservative recruiters?
posts.body: Should I just write 'career transition' on LinkedIn, or be blunt about the layoff?
posts.author: priya

posts.title: The psychological damage of PIP culture
posts.body: PIPs are not designed to help you improve. They are legal protection for companies firing you for free. Fight me.
posts.author: neha

posts.title: Resume review thread for severed product designers
posts.body: Dropping portfolio advice for anyone navigating this brutal hiring market. Happy to critique.
posts.author: neha

posts.title: Do companies still care about cover letters?
posts.body: Spent 2 hours customizing cover letters for 30 jobs. Wondering if anyone actually reads them or ATS dumps them.
posts.author: rahul

posts.title: Lumon Industries homage: Remember we are people first
posts.body: A cold reminder that our labor does not define our souls. Praise Kier, or rather, praise yourself for surviving.

posts.body: Unhelpful corporate apologetics that the community rightly rejected.

posts.title: First day at new job recap
posts.body: After 4 months in severance limbo, today was Day 1. Friendly team, zero toxicity so far. Keep pushing.
